title: The specified finite constant-function scalar map is invertible
statement: For any scheme X and finite discrete topological commutative ring A of Type 0, the specified constant-function map finiteScalarMap X A of [def-sfb-embedded-finite-coefficient-realization] is an isomorphism.

source.place: First paragraph, clauses (1) and (2); Stacks Tags 099L, 03ET, 00YV, 06YQ and 09AL.

proof.text: Use the local injectivity and local surjectivity of the underlying additive constant-to-continuous presheaf map on profinite sets. Its equalizer and image sieves are unchanged when regarded as a ring map, so ring sheafification inverts it. Express constantToContinuous through the sheafification adjunction and comparison isomorphisms, then apply the additive forgetful functor and inverse image from the point to X.
